confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors are rough, crowd-sourced or aggregated estimates from search snippets (Expatistan averages, a Bergen nightlife guide, a Norwegian cost guide and a cost-of-living page), not official surveys. Cocktail and beer ranges vary by 20-50% across sources. Wine glass has no direct Bergen source, so it is derived from the beer anchor using a typical restaurant wine-to-beer price ratio of about 1.3x. Accommodation anchors (dorm, private hostel, 1-star and 3-star hotel) are holistic model estimates for July high season and rest on general knowledge plus the Bergen context; no accommodation searches were run and no booking pages or current listings were inspected. NOK-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of roughly 10 NOK per USD, which was not searched. The FX value 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 came from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page; I did not open that page or the F11 table directly, so it should be verified against the official RBA table before use. Earlier searches returned only March 2026 RBA data, so the latest observation is not confirmed independently.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bergen-specific price data were used for food and drink, with Norway's high restaurant and alcohol price level as the reference. Accommodation uses a holistic estimate for a Norwegian coastal tourist city in July, benchmarked loosely against other high-cost Nordic and Western European tourist cities. No single comparable city was used directly.
